description_en: Submits a video copyright watermark job
description_zh: 调用SubmitCopyrightJob提交视频版权水印任务
name: SubmitCopyrightJob

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URL of the media file to which you want to add a watermark. Currently, only video files are supported. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

The region of the OSS bucket must be the same as the region where MPS is deployed.
  
Bucket: the name of the OSS bucket for the input file.
Location: the region where OSS is deployed. The region must be the same as the region where MPS is deployed.
Object: the OSS object to be processed
parameters.help_zh:
待添加水印的媒体文件OSS地址，目前仅支持视频文件，JSON对象。详细信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致。
  
Bucket：输入文件OSS Bucket名称。
Location：OSS所在地域，必须和MPS服务所在地域一致。
Object：待检测OSS Object
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URL for the output file. The value is a JSON object.

The region of the OSS bucket must be the same as the region where MPS is deployed
parameters.help_zh:
文件输出OSS地址，JSON对象。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The watermark information to be added
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en: The start time of watermark embedding, in seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 水印嵌入开始时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The total duration of watermark embedding, in seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is the duration of the video
parameters.help_zh: 水印嵌入总时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为视频时长
parameters.name: total_time

parameters.help_en: The watermark level, which indicates the embedding channel. Valid values: 0 (u channel), 1 (uv channel), and 2 (yuv channel)
parameters.help_zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv
parameters.name: level

parameters.example: Address: Chuanhe Road, Shangke Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
parameters.help_en: The description of the watermark information
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for the node result. Currently, only HTTP URLs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.help_en: The video URL that supports public network access. If you specify this parameter, it is preferentially used as the node input. Otherwise, the Input parameter is used
parameters.help_zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The custom user data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for the watermark job. The value is a JSON string. The following parameters are supported:

algoType: the algorithm type. Default value: v1.
v1: long video copyright watermark. Only videos longer than 3 minutes are supported.
v2: short video copyright watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。
v1：长视频版权水印，仅支持3min以上的。
v2：短视频版权水印
parameters.name: params
